_comment: Placeholder adapter. Every value is fictional. Each `_about_*` key says what a real value looks like and where the engine reads it. Delete the `_about_*` keys once filled in.
_about_description: One line shown by `up`. Name the real vendor and app.
_about_ports: Loopback ports. `vendor` is where the engine starts your stub; `sidecar` is the capture proxy and monitor; `app` is only used to print an app URL. Add more keys for processes your hooks start. Read by engine/evalenv.py and engine/sidecar.py.
_about_stub: Relative path to the mock vendor the engine starts. Read by engine/evalenv.py _engine_processes.
_about_hooks: Relative path to the hooks module (processes, seed, reset, observe, in_flight, transcript, artifacts, status, down). Read by engine/adapter.py.
_about_vendor_page: Path on the stub that plays the vendor dashboard. Printed by `up`.
_about_upstream: Model provider base URL the sidecar forwards to. null means https://api.openai.com (a real provider; see references/live-provider.md). The demo points this at a local stand-in. EVALENV_UPSTREAM overrides at runtime.
_about_env: Static environment handed to every process. Point your app's model base URL at the sidecar port so calls are captured. Read by engine/evalenv.py build_env.
_about_env_file: Optional path to a .env whose values enter the child environment (a real provider key lives here, never in this file). Relative paths resolve from this folder; ~ is expanded. null means no file is read.
_about_secret_env_keys: Names whose values must never reach stdout, pids.json, or the log. The CLI scrubs them from every printed object.

disposable.description: Say here what your reset hook deletes

_about_disposable: `reset` refuses to run until confirmed is true AND a reset hook exists. Describe exactly what gets deleted (a throwaway database, a session-relative folder). Never point this at real data.
_about_users: Seeded accounts. The stub keys its API by api_key; your seed hook creates the matching app users. Fictional values only.
_about_scenarios: Names the CLI accepts for `scenario <name>`. Each Assumed row from references/vendor-research.md becomes one. Implemented in stub.py.
_about_stages: Your pipeline's stage column values, in order. The stage_order check fails on a backwards move. Read by engine/evals.py.
_about_states: Your item table's state values. processing_state is the one that carries a stage; filed_state is success; terminal_ok_states are non-success ends that are not failures (held for review, dismissed). Read by engine/evals.py and the monitor.

summarize.prompt_prefix: You are a meeting summarization assistant

link.prompt_prefix: You are linking a meeting summary

_about_llm_fingerprints: How the proxy names each model call. body_contains matches the serialized request body; prompt_prefix matches the start of any message content. Keys become the monitor tabs. Read by engine/sidecar.py classify_stage.
_about_llm_call_budget: Model calls allowed per record per run. The llm_call_budget check fails above it.
_about_stage_caps_ms: Latency cap per model-call stage. The stage_caps check fails above it.
_about_labels: Optional display names for states on the monitor.
limitations: Replace with what this adapter does not verify
_about_limitations: Shown in the monitor's Known limitations section and in every snapshot.
